snippet.title: Novanoom | Cinematic Announcement Trailer | Isometric Sci-Fi Action Adventure
snippet.description:
Novanoom is a colorful isometric sci-fi action adventure.
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4847330/Novanoom/

Stranded on an alien world, Alister fights strange creatures and crafts the
tools that open the way forward.

Fight to collect. Craft to unlock. Open the world.

Discord: https://novanoom.com/discord
Press and business: radu@wavemyth.com
Made in Unity by Wavemyth. PC first, on Steam.

#Novanoom #IndieGame #ActionAdventure #SciFi #Steam
